The artifact covers four tiers: (1) the annual EXPO della Sostenibilità startup showcase held in Alba each May; (2) Fondazione DIG421 in nearby Cherasco (25 km), running free Thursday AI/tech public talks; (3) Confindustria Cuneo's annual Stati Generali del Digitale; and (4) the flagship regional event — Wave by Vento (formerly Italian Tech Week) in Turin (65 km), October 7–9, 2026, with 200+ speakers including Dario Amodei and Jony Ive. The article closes with a practical pairing recommendation: Wave days in Turin + Barolo/truffle nights in Alba during peak October truffle season.
